correctness.rationale: For waiting T independent of Exp(h), probability immune before infection is Laplace transform E(exp(-hT)). Strict Jensen gives bound e^(-hT*) with equality iff deterministic T. Mean matching theta_V=1/T* yields P_exp=1/(1+x)>P_fix=e^(-x) for x=hT*>0. Constant inflow gives fluxes p0P and p0(1-P) and stock p0(1-P)/h, with reverse ordering of breakthrough/waiting stock. Derivative d[e^x/(1+x)]/dx=x e^x/(1+x)^2>0. Independently checked six x values, but strict Jensen/competing risk proves arbitrary distributions.
